magic-trifle.title: Nanny's Magic Trifle
magic-trifle.description: A rhyming Christmas treasure hunt through the house: follow the clues from room to room to find Nanny's magic trifle.

credits.text: Bubble text created with Font generator
Arrival of a Princess by Aaron Paul Low
Magic Sound Effect by AnnaBaX01Q (Creative Commons 0 license)

contents.text:
Didi the Duck wants to help you, it’s true,
She knows one of the ingredients, too!
She’s hiding inside a cold little box,
Good luck, clever friends, undoing the locks!

The code to the lock is easy to find
What’s the smallest number that comes to mind?
contents.label: What ingredient does Didi know?

contents.text:
Split into teams with a leader to turn to!
Avery's team one, and Eden's team two
So Ernie's team three
with the twins, you see!
Follow directions, and stick to the plan
Stand on the cross to find the scroll, it's a counting game, so count what you can.
NOW GO TO YOUR ROOM!

You've counted them up, and found the sum,
congratulations, the puzzle's half-done!
Look for a poster to give you a key,
and transform your numbers into A-B-Cs

There's 3 different letters, so what did you find?
It's a word we need, with those letters combined!
contents.label: What's the second ingredient?

contents.text:
Into the hall, you need to go
To where the shoes are on show.
Find a sock that's big and red
Pull out a clue, and use your head!

Some of the squares are specially highlighted
When you figure this out, Nanny's delighted!
It's half the ingredient to go on our list
So tell us now, the magic ingredient we've missed!
contents.label: What's the first half of ingredient 3?

contents.text:
The page you found has a secret key
You'll need it to unlock the next part, you see!
Each number's disguised, and you'll need to find three
To get this ingredient for Nanny's recipe.

On the bookshelf where many tales stand
Find a book about Alice in Wonderland
With the secret code, the book opens wide
What's special about the mystery inside?
contents.label: What's the second half of ingredient 3?

contents.text:
A tiny piano hides down low,
Listen close - it has something to show.
A colourful picture is part of it too,
Join all the clues and the answer will come to you!
contents.label: What magic ingredient can you hear?

contents.text:
Search the Christmas tree, high and low
Three little watches are hiding - go slow!
Find all three watches and bring them back here
The big hand will make the secret clear

Look around to help you do better
and turn those numbers into letters!
It's the fifth magic ingredient that we need to make
Nanny's trifle, so tell us now, for goodness' sake!
contents.label: What's the fifth ingredient?

contents.text:
Auntie Laura's got a secret cipher
To help unlock the box beside her...

Three symbols will open the locks
So you can get at what's in the box!
Eden, Avery, Ernest are a winning combination
or Vicki, Morgan, Harriet...
or Ashley, Nanny, Rich...
It's not just my imagination!
(☂️ = 8)
contents.label: What's in the box?

contents.text:
In the playroom, look around
A wooden box can soon be found.
On the front, a Christmas tree
That's the box that unlocks, with your new key!
(Bring it back to me...)

You've found the last part, now don't delay!
Reveal the recipe and save the day!

Nanny's Magic Trifle recipe
Spin a rainbow
Jump with joy
Ring the bells
Sprinkle with stars
Stir with love
Make a wish
Magic trifle... appear!

One more time!
Spin a rainbow
Jump with joy
Ring the bells
Sprinkle with stars
Stir with love
Make a wish
Magic trifle... appear!

Spin a rainbow
Jump with joy
Ring the bells
Sprinkle with stars
Stir with love
Make a wish
Magic trifle... appear!

rules-demo.title: Demo scenes
rules-demo.description: Pop balloons, dodge the pits, walk around a room with a tiled floor, walls and hills, and cross a bridge over a floor of lava: a demonstration of 2.5D scenes, rules and state, by camera, or by mouse without one.

contents.text:
In a 2.5D scene, things stand on the floor.
They shrink as they go further back,
and you can walk in front of them and behind them.

The near post only notices you when you stand beside it.
A ring follows you around, and your position shows at the bottom.
contents.label: Type walk to start walking

initialState.message: Wave at the floating items, and walk onto the tiles

contents.text:
I have keys, but open no locks.
I have space, but no room.
You can enter, but you can't go in.
What am I?
contents.label: Your answer
